content.title: Exclusive-US moves away from critical mineral price floors, sources say
content.summary: Jan 28 (Reuters) - The Trump administration is stepping back from plans to guarantee a minimum price for U. critical minerals projects, a tacit acknowledgment of a lack of congressional funding and the complexity of setting market pricing, multiple sources told Reuters.

content.title: US Investment In Rival Puts MP Materials Valuation And Outlook In Focus
content.summary: Trump administration announces a US$1.6b investment in USA Rare Earth, along with an equity stake. USA Rare Earth is a direct competitor to MP Materials (NYSE:MP) in the U.S. rare earths sector. The decision marks a shift in federal backing, which had previously centered more on MP Materials. For you as an NYSE:MP watcher, this move reshapes how government support is spread across the rare earths space.
